== Notes ==
* This does not increase the duration of conditions on your target.
* If two foes are close to each other you can permanently maintain conditions on all nearby foes.
* The duration cap is applied before other extending effects. [[Upgrade component]]s (e.g. [[Silencing]] prefixes) can be used to increase durations beyond 30 seconds.
